_comment: Hand-patched spell mechanics for spells the extractor cannot read from prose.
Same pattern as monster_overrides.json: an override is a deliberate,
reviewable statement of what a spell does, not a regex guess.
Only add an entry here when the spell is genuinely combat-relevant AND the
phrasing is too irregular to generalise. Everything patched here is marked
source='override' and confidence=1.0 in the output, and listed in the
'patched' array so the report can show exactly what was hand-fed.
Do NOT use this file to inflate coverage. A utility spell that the sim
genuinely cannot model should stay non-executable so the coverage gate can

magic-missile.note: Auto-hit. Three darts, each 1d4+1 Force; +1 dart per slot above 1st.

eldritch-blast.note: Separate attack roll per beam; beams scale with character level, not slot.

scorching-ray.note: Three rays, each its own attack roll; +1 ray per slot above 2nd.

spirit-guardians.note: Recurring aura damage; the sim applies it once per enemy turn in the aura.

heroism.note: Temp HP equal to the spellcasting modifier at the start of each turn.
